How Voting Rights Impacted the 2026 Midterms

On January 3, Scott Colom will be sworn in as the 52 nd United States Senator from Mississippi. Perhaps more importantly, Colom will be the first Black Mississippian elected to statewide office since Reconstruction —and the first Black Mississippian ever popularly elected to the U.S. Senate by voters in the Magnolia State.
